/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/

/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
holder cycle justifies a right. -/
inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §43). -/
def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
  | none => false

/-- `any` depends only on the values of the predicate on the list (decision procedure for
§43). -/
theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
    l.any f = l.any g
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]

/-- `exR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by
    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
      · simpa using h.2
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
    · exact h
  bound p a h := by
    unfold exR at h; split at h
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · cases h
  loc p q hpq a := by
    unfold exR; split
    · congr 1; split
      · rfl
      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
    · rfl

/-- Soundness of the iteration for `ExercisableAt` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, a, h => by
    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

/-- The frame-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]

/-- The place-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

/-- `ExercisableAt` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih

/-- Decidability of `ExercisableAt` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm

/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m

/-- Decidability of `Grounds` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Decidable (Grounds s m q g) := by
  unfold Grounds; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` is the grounding authority `g` or belongs to its origin chain (§63.4, §69.2,
§70.3: "the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"). -/
def RightChain (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Prop := j = g ∨ j ∈ s.ancs g

/-- Decidability of `RightChain` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (RightChain s g j) := by
  unfold RightChain; infer_instance

/-! ## Dependencies and anchors (§44) -/

/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (§44: dependencies of contained values
are accounted for transitively). -/
def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D

/-- The anchors of every place containing leaf `p` are valid, that is, active (§44; §66.3,
§67.3, §68.3). -/
def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- Decidability of `DepsValid` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- The frame of the effective anchor of `x` (the frame of its holder) exists and is `fd` or an
ancestor of `fd` (§44). -/
def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False

/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOK` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
usable place `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
§44). -/
theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm

/-! ## Outcomes (§58) -/

/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
carries none. -/
inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
  | ok (s : σ)
  | reject
  | fail

/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/
inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

120	instance (m m' : Mode) : Decidable (m.le m') := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∨ _))

122	/-- Authority (§42): own mode, optional origin, footprint (a list of leaves read
123	extensionally), holder, activity. Its identity is its index in `A`. -/
124	structure Authority where
125	  mode : Mode
126	  origin : Option Nat
127	  footprint : List Nat
128	  holder : Holder
129	  active : Bool
130	deriving DecidableEq, Repr

134	structure PinOb where
135	  place : Nat

138	deriving DecidableEq, Repr

141	identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pins` (dynamic pinning obligations,
142	§74, §75) are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
143	structure S3 where
144	  F : Frames
145	  nF : Nat
146	  P : List Place
147	  I : Nat → InitSt
148	  A : List Authority
149	  D : Nat → List Nat

153	/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/

155	
156	/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
157	optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
158	receiving the shape. -/
159	abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

162	`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
163	obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
164	`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
165	fields. -/
166	structure K where
167	  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
168	  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
169	  Pinned : Nat → Prop
170	  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop

202	
203	/-- Predicate on an optional value, `P y` for `some y` and `d` for `none`; used to read the
204	components of `S3` (§38). -/
205	def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=

207	  | some y => P y
208	  | none => d
209

def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe

/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded (§43). -/
def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False

/-- Decidability of `Allows` (§43). -/
instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a` (§42), empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Adds an authority with fresh identity `s.A.length` (§42, §60). -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/

/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
holder cycle justifies a right. -/
inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §43). -/
def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
  | none => false

/-- `any` depends only on the values of the predicate on the list (decision procedure for
§43). -/
theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
    l.any f = l.any g
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]

/-- `exR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by
    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
      · simpa using h.2
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
    · exact h
  bound p a h := by
    unfold exR at h; split at h
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · cases h
  loc p q hpq a := by
    unfold exR; split
    · congr 1; split
      · rfl
      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
    · rfl

/-- Soundness of the iteration for `ExercisableAt` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, a, h => by
    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

/-- The frame-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]

/-- The place-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

/-- `ExercisableAt` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih

/-- Decidability of `ExercisableAt` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm

/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m

/-- Decidability of `Grounds` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Decidable (Grounds s m q g) := by
  unfold Grounds; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` is the grounding authority `g` or belongs to its origin chain (§63.4, §69.2,
§70.3: "the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"). -/
def RightChain (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Prop := j = g ∨ j ∈ s.ancs g

/-- Decidability of `RightChain` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (RightChain s g j) := by
  unfold RightChain; infer_instance

/-! ## Dependencies and anchors (§44) -/

/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (§44: dependencies of contained values
are accounted for transitively). -/
def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D

/-- The anchors of every place containing leaf `p` are valid, that is, active (§44; §66.3,

  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- Decidability of `DepsValid` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- The frame of the effective anchor of `x` (the frame of its holder) exists and is `fd` or an
ancestor of `fd` (§44). -/
def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False

/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOK` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
usable place `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
§44). -/
theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by

  · intro h q _ hq x _

    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm

/-! ## Outcomes (§58) -/

/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
carries none. -/
inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
  | ok (s : σ)
  | reject
  | fail

/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/

  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename.Places

/-!
# Renaming of identities: derived notions of a state

Equivariance of the state-level notions of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` read by
the operations O1–O16 and by the invariants, under related states (§38; §49, last paragraph): the
current frame (§39), origin chains and effective anchors (§42, §44), activity (§42), usability,
frames of places and live holders (§40, §49.8), effective modes (§43), exercise and the
grounding of a right (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3), dependencies (§44), anchor order (§44, §54),
dynamic pinning (§74) and leaves of usable places (§66.1).

Iff lemmas are proved in one direction and closed by symmetry (`SRel.symm`).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

variable {π α : Ren} {s s' : S3}

/-! ## Frames, origins, activity (§39, §42, §44) -/

/-- The current frame is kept (§39; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.top (h : SRel π α s s') : s'.top = s.top := by
  unfold S3.top; rw [h.F]

/-- Origin links correspond (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.org (h : SRel π α s s') (j : Nat) : s'.org (α.f j) = (s.org j).map α.f := by
  simp only [S3.org]
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none j).1 hy]; rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    rw [hy', Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, hr.origin]

/-- Origin chains correspond (§42, §43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.ancs (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (j : Nat) :
    s'.ancs (α.f j) = (s.ancs j).map α.f :=
  chain_ren hd.2 hd'.2 h.org j

/-- Membership in origin chains is invariant (§42, §43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_ancs (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (i j : Nat) :
    α.f j ∈ s'.ancs (α.f i) ↔ j ∈ s.ancs i := by
  rw [h.ancs hd hd', α.mem_map_f]

/-- Effective anchors correspond (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.effAnchor (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (x : Nat) :
    s'.effAnchor (α.f x) = α.f (s.effAnchor x) := by
  unfold S3.effAnchor; rw [h.ancs hd hd', List.getLastD_map]

/-- Activity is invariant (§42, §44; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.active (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) : s'.Active (α.f x) ↔ s.Active x := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
    exact ⟨y, hy, by rw [← hr.active]; exact ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    exact ⟨y', hy', by rw [hr.active]; exact ha⟩

/-- Anchor membership is invariant (§44: `D(p)` is a set; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_D (h : SRel π α s s') (q x : Nat) : α.f x ∈ s'.D (π.f q) ↔ x ∈ s.D q :=
  (h.D q).mem_iff.trans (α.mem_map_f _ _)

/-- Footprint membership is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_footprint (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (l q : Nat) :
    π.f l ∈ footprint s'.P (π.f q) ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q :=
  mem_footprint_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 l q

/-- Footprints correspond up to permutation (§40, §42: a set; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.footprint_perm (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (q : Nat) :
    (footprint s'.P (π.f q)).Perm ((footprint s.P q).map π.f) :=
  footprint_perm_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 q

/-! ## Usability, frames of places, live holders (§40, §49.8) -/

/-- `Usable` is preserved forward (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.usable_of (h : SRel π α s s') {q : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q) : s'.Usable (π.f q) := by
  induction hq with
  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
    rename_i f _
    exact .frame (f := f) (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by rw [h.dead]; exact hd)
      (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) (by rw [h.F]; exact hf)
  | place hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    exact .place (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by rw [h.dead]; exact hd)
      (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih

/-- `Usable` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.usable (h : SRel π α s s') (q : Nat) : s'.Usable (π.f q) ↔ s.Usable q :=
  ⟨fun hq => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.usable_of hq, h.usable_of⟩

/-- Live holders are invariant (§49.8; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.holderLive (h : SRel π α s s') (o : Holder) :
    HolderLive s' (o.ren π) ↔ HolderLive s o := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => show f ∈ s'.F ↔ f ∈ s.F; rw [h.F]
  | place p => exact h.usable p

/-- `FrameOf` is preserved forward (§40, `placeFrame`; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.frameOf_of (h : SRel π α s s') {q f : Nat} (hq : FrameOf s q f) :
    FrameOf s' (π.f q) f := by
  induction hq with
  | frame hpl ho =>
    exact .frame (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren])
  | place hpl ho _ ih =>
    exact .place (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih

/-- `FrameOf` is invariant; frames are not renamed (§40, `placeFrame`; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.frameOf (h : SRel π α s s') (q f : Nat) : FrameOf s' (π.f q) f ↔ FrameOf s q f :=
  ⟨fun hq => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.frameOf_of hq, h.frameOf_of⟩

/-- `placeFrame` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.pframe (h : SRel π α s s') (q : Nat) : s'.pframe (π.f q) = s.pframe q :=
  Option.ext fun f => by rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff, h.frameOf]

/-- The frame of a holder is invariant (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.hframe (h : SRel π α s s') (o : Holder) : s'.hframe (o.ren π) = s.hframe o := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => rfl
  | place p => exact h.pframe p

/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/

/-- Modes of covering active descendants are invariant as a set (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_descModes (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a p : Nat)
    (m : Mode) : m ∈ descModes s' (α.f a) (π.f p) ↔ m ∈ descModes s a p := by
  simp only [Access.mem_descModes]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, y', hy', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    rw [← α.fg j] at hy' h3
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyy⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
    refine ⟨α.g j, y, hy, hyy.active ▸ h1, (hyy.mem_footprint p).1 h2,
      (h.mem_ancs hd hd' _ _).1 h3, hyy.mode ▸ h4⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, y, hy, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hyy⟩ := h.A_some hy
    exact ⟨α.f j, y', hy', hyy.active ▸ h1, (hyy.mem_footprint p).2 h2,
      (h.mem_ancs hd hd' _ _).2 h3, hyy.mode.symm ▸ h4⟩

/-- `effOf` reads its list of modes as a set (§43, cases 2–4; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem effOf_congr {m : Mode} {ds ds' : List Mode} (h : ∀ x, x ∈ ds ↔ x ∈ ds') :
    effOf m ds = effOf m ds' := by
  have h0 : ds = [] ↔ ds' = [] := by simp only [List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem, h]
  simp only [effOf, h0, h Mode.modify]

/-- Effective modes are invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.effective (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a p : Nat) :
    effective s' (α.f a) (π.f p) = effective s a p := by
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => simp only [Access.effective, hy, (h.A_none a).1 hy]
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    simp only [Access.effective, hy, hy', hr.active, hr.mem_footprint, hr.mode,
      effOf_congr (h.mem_descModes hd hd' a p)]

/-- Footprints of authorities correspond up to permutation (§42: a set; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.afp (h : SRel π α s s') (a : Nat) : (s'.afp (α.f a)).Perm ((s.afp a).map π.f) := by
  unfold S3.afp
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none a).1 hy]; exact .nil
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    rw [hy']; exact hr.footprint

/-- Footprint membership of authorities is invariant (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_afp (h : SRel π α s s') (a l : Nat) : π.f l ∈ s'.afp (α.f a) ↔ l ∈ s.afp a :=
  (h.afp a).mem_iff.trans (π.mem_map_f _ _)

/-- Sufficient effective mode over a footprint is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.forall_footprint_allows (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
    (q a : Nat) (m : Mode) :
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P (π.f q), Allows (Access.effective s' (α.f a) l) m) ↔
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (Access.effective s a l) m :=
  π.forall_mem_iff (fun l => h.mem_footprint hd hd' l q)
    (fun l => by rw [h.effective hd hd'])

/-! ## Exercise and rights (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3) -/

/-- `ExercisableAt` is preserved forward (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.exercisableAt_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') {a : Nat}
    {m : Mode} (he : s.ExercisableAt a m) : s'.ExercisableAt (α.f a) m := by
  induction he with
  | base hy ha hm hf =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    exact .base hy' (by rw [hr.active]; exact ha) (by rw [hr.mode]; exact hm)
      (by rw [hr.holder, hf, h.top]; rfl)
  | held hy ha hm hp _ hc ih =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    exact .held hy' (by rw [hr.active]; exact ha) (by rw [hr.mode]; exact hm)
      (by rw [hr.holder, hp]; rfl) ih ((h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' _ _ _).2 hc)

/-- `ExercisableAt` is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.exercisableAt (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a : Nat)
    (m : Mode) : s'.ExercisableAt (α.f a) m ↔ s.ExercisableAt a m :=
  ⟨fun he => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, α.gf] using h.symm.exercisableAt_of hd' hd he,
   h.exercisableAt_of hd hd'⟩

/-- `HasRight` is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.hasRight (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (m : Mode) (q : Nat) :
    HasRight s' m (π.f q) ↔ HasRight s m q :=
  α.exists_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun a =>
    and_congr (h.exercisableAt hd hd' a m) (h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' q a m)

/-- `Grounds` is invariant (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.grounds (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) :
    Grounds s' m (π.f q) (α.f g) ↔ Grounds s m q g :=
  and_congr (h.mem_rangeA g)
    (and_congr (h.exercisableAt hd hd' g m) (h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' q g m))

/-- `RightChain` is invariant (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.rightChain (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (g j : Nat) :
    RightChain s' (α.f g) (α.f j) ↔ RightChain s g j :=
  or_congr α.f_inj (h.mem_ancs hd hd' g j)

/-! ## Dependencies and anchor order (§44, §54) -/

/-- Anchors gathered over the places selected by corresponding predicates correspond up to
permutation (§44: `D(p)` is a set; §63, `ok` effect; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.filter_flatMap_D (h : SRel π α s s') {Q Q' : Nat → Bool}
    (hQ : ∀ r, Q' (π.f r) = Q r) :
    (((List.range s'.P.length).filter Q').flatMap s'.D).Perm
      ((((List.range s.P.length).filter Q).flatMap s.D).map α.f) := by
  have hL : ((List.range s'.P.length).filter Q').Perm
      (((List.range s.P.length).filter Q).map π.f) :=
    π.perm_of_mem (List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range)
      (List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range) fun r => by
        simp only [List.mem_filter, h.P.mem_range, hQ]
  refine (hL.flatMap_right s'.D).trans ?_
  rw [List.flatMap_map, List.map_flatMap]
  exact perm_flatMap_pointwise fun r _ => h.D r

/-- Inherited anchors correspond up to permutation (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.depsOf (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (q : Nat) :
    (Access.depsOf s' (π.f q)).Perm ((Access.depsOf s q).map α.f) :=
  h.filter_flatMap_D fun r => decide_eq_decide.2 (partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 r q)

/-- `DepsValid` is invariant (§44; §66.3, §67.3, §68.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.depsValid (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (p : Nat) :
    DepsValid s' (π.f p) ↔ DepsValid s p :=
  π.forall_mem_iff h.P.mem_range fun q => by
    rw [partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1]
    exact imp_congr_right fun _ => α.forall_mem_iff (h.mem_D q) h.active

/-- `EffAnchorOK` is invariant; frames are not renamed (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.effAnchorOK (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (x : Nat)
    (fd : Option Nat) : EffAnchorOK s' (α.f x) fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK
  rw [h.effAnchor hd hd']
  cases hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none _).1 hz]; exact Iff.rfl
  | some z =>
    obtain ⟨z', hz', hr⟩ := h.A_some hz
    rw [hz']
    simp only [OptP, hr.holder, h.hframe, h.F]

/-- `AnchorOrder` is preserved forward (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.anchorOrder_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
    (ha : AnchorOrder s) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  intro q' hq' x' hx'
  rw [← π.fg q'] at hq' hx' ⊢
  rw [← α.fg x'] at hx' ⊢
  rw [h.pframe, h.effAnchorOK hd hd']
  exact ha _ ((h.usable _).1 hq') _ ((h.mem_D _ _).1 hx')

/-- `AnchorOrder` is invariant (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.anchorOrder (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') :
    AnchorOrder s' ↔ AnchorOrder s :=
  ⟨h.symm.anchorOrder_of hd' hd, h.anchorOrder_of hd hd'⟩

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` is preserved forward (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.anchorOrderHeld_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
    (ha : AnchorOrderHeld s) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  intro q' hq' x' y' hy' ya hh
  rw [← π.fg q'] at hq' hh ⊢
  rw [← α.fg x'] at hy' ⊢
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
  rw [h.pframe, h.effAnchorOK hd hd']
  rw [hr.holder] at hh
  exact ha _ ((h.usable _).1 hq') _ y hy (by rw [← hr.active]; exact ya)
    ((Holder.ren_inj π (b := .place (π.g q'))).1 hh)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` is invariant (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.anchorOrderHeld (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') :
    AnchorOrderHeld s' ↔ AnchorOrderHeld s :=
  ⟨h.symm.anchorOrderHeld_of hd' hd, h.anchorOrderHeld_of hd hd'⟩

/-! ## Dynamic pinning, leaves of usable places (§74, §66.1) -/

/-- Dynamic pinning is invariant (§74; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.pin (h : SRel π α s s') (l : Nat) : s'.pin (π.f l) = s.pin l := by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, S3.pin_iff, S3.pin_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, ob', hob', ha, hl⟩
    obtain ⟨ob, hob, hr⟩ := h.pins_some' hob'
    exact ⟨i, ob, hob, by rw [← hr.active]; exact ha, (hr.mem_leaves l).1 hl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, ob, hob, ha, hl⟩
    obtain ⟨ob', hob', hr⟩ := h.pins_some hob
    exact ⟨i, ob', hob', by rw [hr.active]; exact ha, (hr.mem_leaves l).2 hl⟩

/-- `LeafOfUsable` is invariant (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.leafOfUsable (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (l : Nat) :
    LeafOfUsable s' (π.f l) ↔ LeafOfUsable s l :=
  π.exists_mem_iff h.P.mem_range fun q => and_congr (h.usable q) (h.mem_footprint hd hd' l q)

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

theorem shapeP_get_old {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
    (hq : q < P.length) : (shapeP P hd ls)[q]? = P[q]? :=
  List.getElem?_append_left hq

/-- The appended places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem shapeP_get_new (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
    (i : Nat) : (shapeP P hd ls)[P.length + i]? = if i < ls.length then
      some ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ else none := by
  simp only [shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
    List.getElem?_map]
  split
  · rename_i hi; rw [List.getElem?_range hi]; rfl
  · rename_i hi
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by simp only [List.length_range]; omega)]; rfl

/-- Parents of the former places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem shapeP_parentOf_old {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
    (hq : q < P.length) : parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) q = parentOf P q := by
  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, shapeP_get_old hq]

/-- Parents of the appended places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem shapeP_parentOf_new (P : List Place) (hd : Holder)
    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (i : Nat) :
    parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) (P.length + i) = (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) := by
  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, shapeP_get_new]
  split
  · rfl
  · rename_i hi; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)]; rfl

/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps the relation, the shape not renamed (§71.1, §72.2:
parents and owning elements are fresh; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem shapeP_ren (hP : PRel π P P') {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) (o : Holder) :
    PRel π (shapeP P o ls) (shapeP P' (o.ren π) ls) where
  len := by simp [shapeP, hP.len]
  get q := by
    by_cases hq : q < P.length
    · rw [shapeP_get_old ((hP.lt_iff q).2 hq), shapeP_get_old hq, hP.get]
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = P.length + i := ⟨q - P.length, by omega⟩
      rw [hP.fix _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _), ← hP.len, shapeP_get_new, hP.len, shapeP_get_new]
      split
      · rename_i hi
        have hc := hok i (List.mem_range.2 hi)
        simp only [Option.map_some, Place.ren, Option.some.injEq, Place.mk.injEq, and_true]
        constructor
        · have h1 := hc.1
          revert h1
          cases (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) with
          | none => intro; rfl
          | some r => intro h1; simp only [Option.map_some, hP.fix r h1.1]
        · have h2 := hc.2
          revert h2
          unfold shapeOwner
          cases (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
          | none => intro; rfl
          | some r => intro h2; simp only [Holder.ren, hP.fix r h2.1]
      · rfl
  fix q hq := hP.fix q (Nat.le_trans (by simp [shapeP]) hq)

/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps parent links downward (§71.1, §72.2; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem shapeP_down (hdP : DownP P) {o : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) : DownP (shapeP P o ls) := by
  intro j p hj
  by_cases hq : j < P.length
  · rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hq] at hj; exact hdP j p hj
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = P.length + i := ⟨j - P.length, by omega⟩
    rw [shapeP_parentOf_new] at hj
    have hi : i < ls.length := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hi
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)] at hj; cases hj
    have hc := (hok i (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
    rw [hj] at hc; exact hc.2.1

/-- Appending places keeps field order (§63.2, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph): appended places are
fixed and follow the former ones. -/
theorem shapeP_sib (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) {o : Holder}
    {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} : SibMono π (shapeP P o ls) := by
  intro x y p hx hy hxy
  by_cases hyP : y < P.length
  · have hxP : x < P.length := by omega
    rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hxP] at hx; rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hyP] at hy
    exact hs x y p hx hy hxy
  · rw [hP.fix y (by omega)]
    by_cases hxP : x < P.length
    · have := (hP.lt_iff x).2 hxP; rw [hP.len] at this; omega
    · rw [hP.fix x (by omega)]; exact hxy

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Renaming of identities: core definitions

Foundation of the renaming bisimulation of the access kernel for
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §49, last paragraph: renamings of place and
authority identities (`Ren`), the relation they induce on places, authorities, pinning
obligations (§74, §75) and states (§38), the order facts carried along runs (`Down`, `SibMono`),
the renamed contract (§48, §80), the renamed operations (§60–§75), and the relation of outcomes
(§58). Generic lemmas on these relations, closed by symmetry.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Rename

/-! ## Renamings (§49, last paragraph) -/

/-- A renaming of identities (§49, last paragraph): a bijection of `Nat` with its inverse. -/
    PinRel (π'.comp π) ob ob'' where
  place := by rw [h'.place, h.place]; rfl
  leaves := h'.leaves.trans ((h.leaves.map π'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
  active := h'.active.trans h.active

/-- Symmetry of related states (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.symm (h : SRel π α s s') : SRel π.symm α.symm s' s where
  F := h.F.symm
  nF := h.nF.symm
  P := h.P.symm
  I l := by have := h.I (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
  Alen := h.Alen.symm
  A x := by
    have := optionRel_symm (fun _ _ hy => AuthRel.symm hy) (h.A (α.g x))
    rw [α.fg] at this; exact this
  Afix x hx := by
    have := h.Afix x (h.Alen ▸ hx)
    show α.g x = x
    conv => lhs; rw [← this]
    exact α.gf x
  D q := by
    have := (h.D (π.g q)).map α.g
    rw [π.fg, Ren.map_gf] at this; exact this.symm
  dead q := by have := h.dead (π.g q); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
  pins o := optionRel_symm (fun _ _ hy => PinRel.symm hy) (h.pins o)

/-- Transitivity of related states (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.trans (h : SRel π α s s') (h' : SRel π' α' s' s'') :
    SRel (π'.comp π) (α'.comp α) s s'' where
  F := h'.F.trans h.F
  nF := h'.nF.trans h.nF
  P := h.P.trans h'.P
  I l := (h'.I (π.f l)).trans (h.I l)
  Alen := h'.Alen.trans h.Alen
  A x := optionRel_trans (r := AuthRel π α) (r' := AuthRel π' α')
    (r'' := AuthRel (π'.comp π) (α'.comp α))
    (fun _ _ _ hy hy' => AuthRel.trans hy hy') (h.A x) (h'.A (α.f x))
  Afix x hx := by
    show α'.f (α.f x) = x
    rw [h.Afix x hx, h'.Afix x (h.Alen ▸ hx)]
  D q := (h'.D (π.f q)).trans (((h.D q).map α'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
  dead q := (h'.dead (π.f q)).trans (h.dead q)
  pins o := optionRel_trans (r := PinRel π) (r' := PinRel π') (r'' := PinRel (π'.comp π))
    (fun _ _ _ hy hy' => PinRel.trans hy hy') (h.pins o) (h'.pins o)

/-- Related states with the same new frame stack are related (§38, §39; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.withF (h : SRel π α s s') (F₀ : Frames) :
    SRel π α { s with F := F₀ } { s' with F := F₀ } :=
  { h with F := rfl }

/-- An existing authority has a related authority (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.A_some (h : SRel π α s s') {x : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[x]? = some y) :
    ∃ y', s'.A[α.f x]? = some y' ∧ AuthRel π α y y' :=
  optionRel_some (h.A x) hy

/-- An existing renamed authority has a related authority (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.A_some' (h : SRel π α s s') {x : Nat} {y' : Authority}
    (hy : s'.A[α.f x]? = some y') : ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ AuthRel π α y y' :=
  optionRel_some' (h.A x) hy

/-- Authorities are absent together (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.A_none (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) : s.A[x]? = none ↔ s'.A[α.f x]? = none :=
  optionRel_none_iff (h.A x)

/-- An existing obligation has a related obligation (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.pins_some (h : SRel π α s s') {o : Nat} {ob : PinOb} (hob : s.pins[o]? = some ob) :
    ∃ ob', s'.pins[o]? = some ob' ∧ PinRel π ob ob' :=
  optionRel_some (h.pins o) hob

/-- An existing obligation of the related state has a related obligation (§74, §75; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.pins_some' (h : SRel π α s s') {o : Nat} {ob' : PinOb}
    (hob : s'.pins[o]? = some ob') : ∃ ob, s.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ PinRel π ob ob' :=
  optionRel_some' (h.pins o) hob

/-- Obligations are absent together (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.pins_none (h : SRel π α s s') (o : Nat) : s.pins[o]? = none ↔ s'.pins[o]? = none :=
  optionRel_none_iff (h.pins o)

/-- Related states have related authority bounds (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.Alt (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) : α.f x < s'.A.length ↔ x < s.A.length := by
  have := h.A_none x
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff] at this
  omega

/-- Membership in the authority range, renamed (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) :
    α.f x ∈ List.range s'.A.length ↔ x ∈ List.range s.A.length := by
  simp only [List.mem_range, h.Alt]

/-- Universal quantification over the authorities, renamed (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.forall_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
    (∀ y ∈ List.range s'.A.length, Q y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, Q (α.f x) :=
  α.forall_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-- Existential quantification over the authorities, renamed (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.exists_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
    (∃ y ∈ List.range s'.A.length, Q y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, Q (α.f x) :=
  α.exists_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-- `WF3` gives downward links (§49.2, §49.5; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Down.of_wf3 (hw : WF3 s) : Down s := by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ hp => (hw.parent_lt hp).1, fun j o ho => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyo⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.1 ho
  exact hw.origins j y o hy hyo

/-- Field order kept by `π` is kept by its inverse on the related list (§63.2; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem SibMono.symm (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) : SibMono π.symm P' := by
  have hpar : ∀ x p, parentOf P' x = some p → parentOf P (π.g x) = some (π.g p) := by
    intro x p hx
    have := hP.get (π.g x)
    rw [π.fg] at this
    simp only [parentOf, this] at hx ⊢
    cases e : P[π.g x]? with
    | none => rw [e] at hx; cases hx
    | some pl =>
      rw [e] at hx
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, Place.ren] at hx
      cases hpp : pl.parent with
      | none => rw [hpp] at hx; cases hx
      | some r =>
        rw [hpp] at hx; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hx
        simp only [Option.bind_some, hpp, ← hx, π.gf]
  intro x y p hx hy hxy
  simp only [Ren.symm_f]
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy (π.g x) (π.g y) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exact hlt
  · exact absurd ((by rw [← π.fg x, heq, π.fg] : x = y) ▸ hxy) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  · have := hs _ _ _ (hpar y p hy) (hpar x p hx) hgt
    rw [π.fg, π.fg] at this; omega

/-- Field order depends only on the parent links (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SibMono.congr {P₁ : List Place} (hpar : parentOf P₁ = parentOf P) (hs : SibMono π P) :
    SibMono π P₁ := by
  intro x y p hx hy; rw [hpar] at hx hy; exact hs x y p hx hy

/-- Symmetry of the simulation invariant (§49, last paragraph; §57). -/
theorem Sim.symm (hS : Sim π α s s') : Sim π.symm α.symm s' s where
  rel := hS.rel.symm
  down := hS.down'
  down' := hS.down
  sib := SibMono.symm hS.rel.P hS.sib

/-- The renamed contract corresponds to the contract (§48, §80; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem KCorr.rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : KCorr π α k (k.rename π α) where
  dd r r' := by simp only [K.rename, Ren.map_gf]
  shared l := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
  pinned l := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
  done _ := Iff.rfl
  dealloc p := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
  compat p a := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]

/-- Symmetry of corresponding contracts (§48, §80; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem KCorr.symm {k k' : K} (hK : KCorr π α k k') : KCorr π.symm α.symm k' k where
  dd r r' := by
    have := hK.dd (r.map π.g) (r'.map π.g)
    rw [Ren.map_fg, Ren.map_fg] at this; exact this.symm
  shared l := by have := hK.shared (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
  pinned l := by have := hK.pinned (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
  done o := (hK.done o).symm
  dealloc p := by have := hK.dealloc (π.g p); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
  compat p a := by have := hK.compat (π.g p) a; rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm

/-- `DDSound` (§80, §23) is invariant under renaming of the contract (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem ddSound_rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : DDSound (k.rename π α) ↔ DDSound k := by
  constructor
  · intro h r r' hd l hl hl'
    have hd' : (k.rename π α).DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.f) (r'.map π.f) := by
      simp only [K.rename, Ren.map_gf]; exact hd
    exact h _ _ hd' (π.f l) ((π.mem_map_f _ _).2 hl) ((π.mem_map_f _ _).2 hl')
  · intro h r r' hd l hl hl'
    exact h _ _ hd (π.g l) (List.mem_map_of_mem hl) (List.mem_map_of_mem hl')

/-- Guarded steps with corresponding preconditions and related effects correspond (§58; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem guarded_corr {Pre Pre' : Prop} {e e' : S3} (hp : Pre' ↔ Pre)
    (he : Pre → SRel π α e e') : StepCorr π α (Guarded Pre e) (Guarded Pre' e') := by
  constructor
  · intro o ho
    cases ho with
    | ok hpre => exact ⟨.ok e', .ok (hp.2 hpre), he hpre⟩
    | reject hpre => exact ⟨.reject, .reject (fun h' => hpre (hp.1 h')), trivial⟩
  · intro o' ho'
    cases ho' with
    | ok hpre => exact ⟨.ok e, .ok (hp.1 hpre), he (hp.1 hpre)⟩
    | reject hpre => exact ⟨.reject, .reject (fun h => hpre (hp.2 h)), trivial⟩

end

/-- Renaming the arguments by the inverse, then by the renaming, gives the operation back (§60–§75;
§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem KernelOp.ren_symm_ren (π α : Ren) (op : KernelOp) :
    (op.ren π.symm α.symm).ren π α = op := by
  cases op <;>
    simp [KernelOp.ren, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.fg, α.fg]

/-- Renaming the arguments, then by the inverse, gives the operation back (§60–§75; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem KernelOp.symm_ren_ren (π α : Ren) (op : KernelOp) :
    (op.ren π α).ren π.symm α.symm = op :=
  KernelOp.ren_symm_ren π.symm α.symm op

end Rename

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- Places with the same owner have the same frame (§40, `placeFrame`). -/
theorem pframe_eq_of_owner {s : S3} {q r : Nat} {pq pr : Place} (hq : s.P[q]? = some pq)
    (hr : s.P[r]? = some pr) (h : pr.owner = pq.owner) : s.pframe r = s.pframe q := by
  simp only [S3.pframe, pframeF, hq, hr, h]

/-! ## Indexed maps (§72, §73) -/

/-- `mapI` preserves the length (effects of §72 and §73). -/
theorem length_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α), (mapI f i l).length = l.length
  | _, [] => rfl
  | i, _ :: l => by simp [mapI, length_mapI f (i + 1) l]

/-- Element `j` of `mapI f i l` is `f (i + j)` applied to element `j` of `l` (effects of §72 and
§73). -/
theorem getElem?_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α) (j : Nat), (mapI f i l)[j]? = (l[j]?).map (f (i + j))
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | i, a :: l, 0 => by simp [mapI]
  | i, a :: l, j + 1 => by
    simp only [mapI, List.getElem?_cons_succ, getElem?_mapI f (i + 1) l j]
    congr 2; omega

/-! ## Guarded transitions (§58) -/

/-- A guarded transition has one outcome (§58). -/
theorem Guarded.det {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 σ}
    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- The `ok` outcome of a guarded transition: the preconditions hold and the state is the effect
(§58). -/
theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩

/-!
# Access kernel: preservation by `enterFrame` and `exitFrame`

Operations O6 `enterFrame` (§72) and O7 `exitFrame` (§73) of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, with the frame rules of §39 and the parameter and
reanchoring rules of §45. Both steps preserve the kernel invariant of §57 (`KInv`, with the active
origins of `I2`, §51) and, separately, the auxiliary invariant `KAux` (not a clause of §57) and
`I5` (§57). The file also proves entry protection of parameters (§72.3 and
the last paragraph of §72), the release of authorities whose holder dies at the exit (§73
effect, §39), the absence of dangling authorities after the exit (§73, §54), reanchoring to the
first surviving active origin (§73.4, §73 effect), and determinism of both steps (§58).

Helper lemmas live in the namespace `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Frames`.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Frames

/-! ## Lists -/

/-- Indices of `List.range` are strictly increasing (§72: identities of the root locals). -/
theorem range_pairwise_lt : ∀ n, (List.range n).Pairwise (· < ·)
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [List.range_succ, List.pairwise_append]
    refine ⟨range_pairwise_lt n, List.pairwise_singleton _ _, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb; subst hb; exact List.mem_range.1 ha

/-- In a strictly increasing list, a value sits at one index only (§72: identities of the root
locals). -/
theorem getElem?_inj_of_lt : ∀ {l : List Nat} {i j x : Nat}, l.Pairwise (· < ·) →
    l[i]? = some x → l[j]? = some x → i = j
  | [], _, _, _, _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | _ :: _, 0, 0, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: l, 0, j + 1, x, hp, hi, hj => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hi; subst hi
    have := (List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).1 _ (List.mem_of_getElem? hj)
    exact absurd this (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  | _ :: l, i + 1, 0, x, hp, hi, hj => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hj; subst hj
    have := (List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).1 _ (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)
    exact absurd this (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  | _ :: l, i + 1, j + 1, x, hp, hi, hj => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at hi hj
    rw [getElem?_inj_of_lt (List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).2 hi hj]

/-- A member of a list sits at some index (§72: the root locals). -/
theorem exists_getElem?_of_mem {α : Type} {a : α} : ∀ {l : List α}, a ∈ l →
    ∃ k : Nat, l[k]? = some a
  | b :: l, h => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_getElem?_of_mem h; exact ⟨k + 1, by simpa using hk⟩

/-- An element of the mapped suffix of an appended list has an index (§72: the root authorities
of the locals). -/
theorem append_map_get {α β : Type} (A₀ : List β) (g : α → β) {l : List α} {a : α} (h : a ∈ l) :
    ∃ j, (A₀ ++ l.map g)[A₀.length + j]? = some (g a) := by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_getElem?_of_mem h
  exact ⟨j, by rw [List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
    List.getElem?_map, hj]; rfl⟩

/-! ## Shapes of locals (§72.2) -/

/-- A local shape has as many elements as its shape (§72). -/
theorem toShape_length (ls : LocalShape) : ls.toShape.length = ls.length := by
  simp [LocalShape.toShape]

/-- No local has an owning element (§72, §39: locals are owned by the new frame). -/
theorem toShape_owner (ls : LocalShape) (i : Nat) : (ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = none := by
  simp only [LocalShape.toShape, List.getElem?_map]; cases ls[i]? <;> rfl

/-- Every local is owned by the receiving holder (§72 `ok` effect, §39). -/
theorem shapeOwner_toShape (ls : LocalShape) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) :
    shapeOwner ls.toShape hd i = hd := by
  simp only [shapeOwner, toShape_owner]

/-- Root locals are elements of the shape without parent (§40, §72). -/
theorem rootIdx_mem {ls : LocalShape} {k i : Nat} (h : (rootIdx ls.toShape)[k]? = some i) :
    i < ls.length ∧ (ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
  have := List.mem_of_getElem? h
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none] at this
  rw [toShape_length] at this; exact this

/-- An element without parent is a root local (§40, §72). -/
theorem mem_rootIdx {ls : LocalShape} {k : Nat} (hk : k < ls.length)
    (hn : (ls.toShape[k]?).bind (·.1) = none) : k ∈ rootIdx ls.toShape := by
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, toShape_length, hk, hn,
    Option.isNone_none, and_self]

/-- Root locals have distinct positions (§72: one root authority per root local). -/
theorem rootIdx_inj {ls : LocalShape} {k k' i : Nat} (h : (rootIdx ls.toShape)[k]? = some i)
    (h' : (rootIdx ls.toShape)[k']? = some i) : k = k' :=
  getElem?_inj_of_lt ((range_pairwise_lt _).filter _) h h'

/-- The parent of a local is an earlier local (§72.2, `ShapeOK`). -/
theorem shape_parent {n : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hsh : ShapeOK n ls.toShape) {i r : Nat}
    (hi : i < ls.length) (hr : (ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1) = some r) : n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i := by
  have := (hsh i (List.mem_range.2 (by rw [toShape_length]; exact hi))).1
  rw [hr] at this; exact ⟨this.1, this.2.1⟩

/-! ## Origin chains and effective anchors (§42, §44) -/

/-- Under the origin order of `WF3` (§49.5), the origin of an authority precedes it. -/
theorem org_lt {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {x o : Nat} (h : s.org x = some o) : o < x := by
  simp only [S3.org] at h
  cases hy : s.A[x]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at h; cases h
  | some y => rw [hy] at h; exact hw.origins x y o hy h

/-- One step of an origin chain (§42): the chain starts with the origin when it is smaller, or
it is empty. -/
theorem ancs_step {s : S3} {x o : Nat} (h : s.org x = some o) :
    (o < x ∧ s.ancs x = o :: s.ancs o) ∨ s.ancs x = [] := by
  by_cases hlt : o < x
  · exact .inl ⟨hlt, chain_cons h hlt⟩
  · right; unfold S3.ancs chain
    cases x with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => simp [chainF, h, hlt]

/-- Under the origin order of `WF3` (§49.5), the origin chain of `x` reaches a root authority:
some element of `x` and its ancestors has no origin. -/
theorem reaches_root {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n x, x < n → ∃ r, (r = x ∨ r ∈ s.ancs x) ∧ s.org r = none
  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx => by

(hd : s.dead q = false) (h : HolderLive s pl.owner) : s.Usable q := by
  cases ho : pl.owner with
  | frame f => rw [ho] at h; exact .frame hpl hd ho h
  | place o => rw [ho] at h; exact .place hpl hd ho h

/-! ## Places after `enterFrame` (§72 `ok` effect) -/

section Enter

variable {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}

/-- The locals are appended to the places (§72 `ok` effect). -/
theorem enterP_len (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) :
    (enterP s ls).length = s.P.length + ls.length := by
  simp [enterP, shapeP, toShape_length]

/-- Existing places are unchanged by `enterFrame` (§72 `ok` effect). -/
theorem enterP_lt {q : Nat} (h : q < s.P.length) : (enterP s ls)[q]? = s.P[q]? :=
  List.getElem?_append_left h

/-- Local `i` is the place `|P| + i`, owned by the new frame (§72 `ok` effect, §39). -/
theorem enterP_new {i : Nat} (h : i < ls.length) : (enterP s ls)[s.P.length + i]? =
    some ⟨(ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1), .frame s.nF, ((ls.toShape[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
  simp only [enterP, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _),
    Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, List.getElem?_map,
    List.getElem?_range (show i < ls.toShape.length by rw [toShape_length]; exact h),
    Option.map_some, shapeOwner_toShape]

/-- A place after `enterFrame` is an existing place or a local owned by the new frame (§72 `ok`
effect). -/
theorem enterP_get {q : Nat} {pl : Place} (h : (enterP s ls)[q]? = some pl) :
    (q < s.P.length ∧ s.P[q]? = some pl) ∨ (s.P.length ≤ q ∧ ∃ i, i < ls.length ∧
      q = s.P.length + i ∧ pl = ⟨(ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1), .frame s.nF,
        ((ls.toShape[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩) := by
  by_cases hq : q < s.P.length
  · exact .inl ⟨hq, by rwa [enterP_lt hq] at h⟩
  · have hi : q - s.P.length < ls.length := by
      have := lt_of_getElem? h; rw [enterP_len] at this; omega
    have e : q = s.P.length + (q - s.P.length) := by omega
    rw [e, enterP_new hi] at h; cases h
    exact .inr ⟨by omega, _, hi, e, rfl⟩

/-- An authority after `enterFrame` is an existing one, moved to the new frame if it is a
parameter, or the root authority of a root local, held by the new frame (§72 `ok` effect). -/
theorem enter_get {j : Nat} {z : Authority} (h : (enterEff s ps ls).A[j]? = some z) :
    (j < s.A.length ∧ ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧
      z = if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) ∨
    (s.A.length ≤ j ∧ ∃ i, (rootIdx ls.toShape)[j - s.A.length]? = some i ∧
      z = ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), .frame s.nF, true⟩) := by
  simp only [enterEff] at h
  by_cases hj : j < s.A.length
  · have hj' : j < (mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0
        s.A).length := by rw [length_mapI]; exact hj
    rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj', getElem?_mapI] at h
    cases hy : s.A[j]? with
    | none => rw [hy] at h; cases h
    | some y => rw [hy] at h; cases h; exact .inl ⟨hj, y, rfl, by simp⟩
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [length_mapI]; omega), length_mapI,
      List.getElem?_map] at h
    cases hi : (rootIdx ls.toShape)[j - s.A.length]? with
    | none => rw [hi] at h; cases h
    | some i =>
      rw [hi] at h; cases h
      exact .inr ⟨by omega, i, rfl, by simp only [shapeOwner_toShape]⟩

/-- Existing authorities after `enterFrame`: only parameters change, and only their holder
(§72 `ok` effect). -/
theorem enter_lt {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) : (enterEff s ps ls).A[j]? =
    (s.A[j]?).map fun y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y := by
  simp only [enterEff]
  rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [length_mapI]; exact h), getElem?_mapI]; simp

/-- Origins of existing authorities are unchanged by `enterFrame` (§72: no additional right). -/
theorem enter_org_lt {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) : (enterEff s ps ls).org j = s.org j := by
  simp only [S3.org, enter_lt h]
  cases s.A[j]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- Origin chains of existing authorities are unchanged by `enterFrame` (§72). -/
theorem enter_ancs_lt {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) : (enterEff s ps ls).ancs j = s.ancs j :=
  chain_congr fun _ hi => enter_org_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hi h)

/-- The parent of local `i` (§72.2). -/
theorem enter_parentOf_new {i : Nat} (h : i < ls.length) :
    parentOf (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i) = (ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1) := by
  simp [parentOf, enterP_new h]

/-- Parents of existing places are unchanged by `enterFrame` (§72). -/
theorem enter_parentOf_lt {q : Nat} (h : q < s.P.length) :
    parentOf (enterP s ls) q = parentOf s.P q := by
  simp [parentOf, enterP_lt h]

/-- The footprint of a local is made of locals (§40, §72.2). -/
theorem enter_root_fp_ge {i l : Nat} (h : l ∈ footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i)) :
    s.P.length ≤ l := by
      rw [show s.P.length + (q - s.P.length) = q by omega] at hu
      exact hq hu

end Enter

/-! ## The first surviving origin (§73.4) -/

/-- The first surviving element of a list survives and belongs to it (§73.4). -/
theorem firstSurv_some {s : S3} {F₀ : Frames} {l : List Nat} {z : Nat}
    (h : firstSurv s F₀ l = some z) : z ∈ l ∧ Survives s F₀ z :=
  ⟨List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h, by simpa using List.find?_some h⟩

/-- No element of a list without first surviving element survives (§73.4). -/
theorem firstSurv_none {s : S3} {F₀ : Frames} {l : List Nat} (h : firstSurv s F₀ l = none) :
    ∀ w ∈ l, ¬ Survives s F₀ w := by
  intro w hw hs
  have := List.find?_eq_none.1 h w hw
  simp [hs] at this

/-- The first surviving strict ancestor (§73.4): an ancestor that survives, such that every
surviving ancestor is it or one of its own ancestors. -/
theorem firstSurv_ancs {s : S3} {F₀ : Frames} :
    ∀ n x, x < n → ∀ z, firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs x) = some z →
      z ∈ s.ancs x ∧ Survives s F₀ z ∧
        ∀ w ∈ s.ancs x, Survives s F₀ w → w = z ∨ w ∈ s.ancs z
  | 0, _, h, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx, z, hz => by
    cases ho : s.org x with
    | none => rw [S3.ancs, chain_none ho] at hz; simp [firstSurv] at hz
    | some o =>
      obtain ⟨hlt, he⟩ : o < x ∧ s.ancs x = o :: s.ancs o := by
        rcases ancs_step ho with h | he
        · exact h
        · rw [he] at hz; simp [firstSurv] at hz
      rw [he] at hz ⊢
      by_cases hs : Survives s F₀ o
      · simp only [firstSurv, List.find?_cons_of_pos (p := fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z))
          (by simpa using hs), Option.some.injEq] at hz
        subst hz
        refine ⟨List.mem_cons_self .., hs, fun w hw' _ => ?_⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hw' with rfl | hw'
        · exact .inl rfl
        · exact .inr hw'
      · simp only [firstSurv, List.find?_cons_of_neg (p := fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z))
          (by simpa using hs)] at hz
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := firstSurv_ancs n o (by omega) z hz
        refine ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h1, h2, fun w hw' hws => ?_⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hw' with rfl | hw'
        · exact absurd hws hs
        · exact h3 w hw' hws

/-! ## Authorities after `exitFrame` (§73 `ok` effect) -/

section Exit

variable {s : S3}

/-- Authority `j` after the exit (§73 `ok` effect). -/
theorem exit_A_get (s : S3) (j : Nat) :
    (exitEff s).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map (exitG s s.F.tail j) := by
  simp [exitEff, getElem?_mapI]

/-- An authority after the exit comes from the authority of the same identity (§73). -/
theorem exit_get {j : Nat} {z : Authority} (hz : (exitEff s).A[j]? = some z) :
    ∃ z₀, s.A[j]? = some z₀ ∧ z = exitG s s.F.tail j z₀ := by
  rw [exit_A_get] at hz
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hz
  exact ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩

/-- Reanchoring and release change neither the own mode, nor the footprint, nor the holder
(§73 `ok` effect, fourth item). -/
theorem exitG_same (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) :
    (exitG s F₀ a y).mode = y.mode ∧ (exitG s F₀ a y).footprint = y.footprint ∧
    (exitG s F₀ a y).holder = y.holder := by
  unfold exitG; split
  · split <;> simp
  · simp

/-- An authority active after the exit survives (§73 `ok` effect, second item). -/
theorem exitG_active {F₀ : Frames} {a : Nat} {y : Authority} :
    (exitG s F₀ a y).active = true → Survives s F₀ a := by
  unfold exitG; split
  · intro; assumption
  · simp

/-- A surviving authority stays active (§73 `ok` effect). -/
theorem exitG_surv {F₀ : Frames} {a : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (h : Survives s F₀ a) : (exitG s F₀ a y).active = true := by
  have hya : y.active = true := by unfold Survives at h; rw [hy] at h; exact h.1
  unfold exitG; simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]; split <;> simpa using hya

/-- An authority active after the exit was active before (§73 `ok` effect). -/
theorem exitG_active' {F₀ : Frames} {a : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (h : (exitG s F₀ a y).active = true) : y.active = true := by
  have := exitG_active h; unfold Survives at this; rw [hy] at this; exact this.1

/-- The origin after the exit is unchanged, or it is the first surviving ancestor of a surviving
derived authority (§73 `ok` effect, third item). -/
theorem exitG_origin {F₀ : Frames} {a : Nat} {y : Authority} :
    (exitG s F₀ a y).origin = y.origin ∨
    (Survives s F₀ a ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ (exitG s F₀ a y).origin = firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a)) := by
  unfold exitG; split
  · rename_i hs; split
    · exact .inl rfl
    · rename_i o ho; exact .inr ⟨hs, by simp [ho], rfl⟩
  · exact .inl rfl

/-- The origin of a surviving authority after the exit is the first surviving ancestor of its
chain (§73 `ok` effect, third item; §73.4). -/
theorem exitG_origin_surv {F₀ : Frames} {a o : Nat} {y : Authority} (hs : Survives s F₀ a)
    (h : (exitG s F₀ a y).origin = some o) : firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) = some o := by
  unfold exitG at h; simp only [hs, ↓reduceIte] at h
  cases hy : y.origin with
  | none => simp only [hy] at h; cases h
  | some _ => simpa only [hy] using h

/-- After the exit, surviving ancestors of an authority are still its ancestors (§73.4). -/
theorem exit_ancs_keep :
    ∀ n x, x < n → ∀ w ∈ s.ancs x, Survives s s.F.tail w → w ∈ (exitEff s).ancs x
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx, w, hw', hws => by
    cases hy : s.A[x]? with
    | none =>
      have : s.org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy]
      rw [S3.ancs, chain_none this] at hw'; simp at hw'
    | some y =>
      cases ho : y.origin with
      | none =>
        have : s.org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]
        rw [S3.ancs, chain_none this] at hw'; simp at hw'
      | some o =>
        have hob : s.org x = some o := by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]
        obtain ⟨hlt, hax⟩ : o < x ∧ s.ancs x = o :: s.ancs o := by
          rcases ancs_step hob with h | hax
          · exact h
          · rw [hax] at hw'; simp at hw'

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.DeriveSplitRelease
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Transfer
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Small
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Frames
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.EndFree
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Alloc

/-!
# Access kernel: steps, reachable states and the main invariant

Assembles the per-operation results of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.*` into the statements of
§57, §58 and §59 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`:

* kernel operations O1–O16 as data, their outcome relation, and the correspondence of `KStep` and
  `Reachable` with the labelled steps and their reflexive-transitive closure (§57, §58);
* preservation of `KInv` (§57) by every step, `transfer` (§63) included, from states satisfying
  `KInv` and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`; preservation of the auxiliaries `KAux` and
  `HeldAnchored` by every step; preservation of `I5` (§57) by every step from a `WF3` state;
* the initial state satisfies the invariant and the auxiliaries under `StaticsOK` (§47), and its
  `Init` leaves are the declared ones;
* the main invariant on reachable states (§57, `reachable_kinv`) and `I5` on reachable states
  (`reachable_i5`); the ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9
  (`reachable_cycle_rejected`);
* §59: only writes and transfers make a leaf `Init`, and every `Init` leaf of a reached state was
  declared or written on the run; §39: frame 0 stays at the bottom of the stack; §58: only `alloc`
  fails.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

34:inductive KernelOp where
46:  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
48:  | exit
69:def KernelOp.Step (k : K) : KernelOp → S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop
97:    | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
98:    | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
115:    | enter => exact .enter h
116:    | exit => exact .exit h
168:  | enter h => exact enter_keeps_base h
169:  | exit h => exact (exit_keeps_base h).2
432:def LocalShape.toShape (ls : LocalShape) : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
469:def enterP (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place := shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls.toShape
479:      (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
481:          shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame s.nF) i, true⟩
505:  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape

/-! ## Kernel operations as data (§58, §60–§75) -/

/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). -/
inductive KernelOp where
  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/
  | release (a : Nat)
  /-- O4 `transfer` (§63). -/
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  /-- O5 `depend` (§64). -/
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  /-- O6 `enterFrame` (§72). -/
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  /-- O7 `exitFrame` (§73). -/
  | exit
  /-- O9 `read` (§66). -/
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  /-- O10 `write` (§67). -/
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  /-- O11 `writeShared` (§68). -/
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  /-- O15 `pin` (§74). -/
  | pin (p : Nat)
  /-- O16 `unpin` (§75), designating the dynamic pinning obligation of identity `o`. -/
  | unpin (o : Nat)
  /-- O12 `endUse` (§69). -/
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  /-- O13 `free` (§70). -/
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  /-- O14 `alloc` (§71). -/
  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  /-- O8 `store` (§65). -/
  | store (a p : Nat)

/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation (§58, §60–§75): the step relation of the operation. -/
def KernelOp.Step (k : K) : KernelOp → S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop
  | .derive src region m => DeriveStep src region m
  | .split src rs => SplitStep k src rs
  | .release a => ReleaseStep a
  | .transfer src dst => TransferStep k src dst
  | .depend q x => DependStep q x
  | .enter ps ls => EnterStep ps ls
  | .exit => ExitStep k
  | .read a ls => Read3Step a ls
  | .write a ls => Write3Step a ls
  | .writeShared a ls => WriteSharedStep k a ls
  | .pin p => PinStep p
  | .unpin o => UnpinStep k o
  | .endUse p => EndUseStep k p
  | .free p auth => FreeStep k p auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls => AllocStep k pr ow ls
  | .store a p => StoreStep a p

/-- A kernel step is the `ok` outcome of some operation O1–O16 (§57, §58). -/
theorem kstep_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' ↔ ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
    | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩
    | release h => exact ⟨.release _, h⟩
    | transfer h => exact ⟨.transfer _ _, h⟩
    | depend h => exact ⟨.depend _ _, h⟩
    | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
    | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
    | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
    | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _, h⟩
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/

/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/
def LocalShape.toShape (ls : LocalShape) : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
  ls.map fun e => (e.1, none, e.2)

/-- Owner of element `i` of a shape (§47, §72, §71): its owning element if any, `hd`
otherwise. -/
def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => hd
